name: r5-conn-once-uplinks
description: Fix round connections (item 6, unordered-result audit): store.js recentUplinkTimes selects the last ten uplinks with recorded_at >= since-date AND recorded_at < next-day AND julianday(recorded_at) BETWEEN ... ORDER BY julianday(recorded_at) DESC LIMIT 10. Go had only the julianday bound, so rows Node-RED's text bounds drop took LIMIT slots and changed the median uplink interval (once_interval_minutes) stored with the confirmation window.

steps.why: Start with owned, foreign and unclaimed device records. Radio provisioning only creates or claims a device for the caller and cannot reproduce all these starting states.

steps.why: Attach the fixture devices to the HTTP-created zone and configure a second hardware generation without calling ChirpStack provisioning.

An uncertain one-time enqueue attempted at 2026-11-20T12:00:00.000Z, with no saved confirmation window: the schedule list computes and stores it from the valve's uplinks of the 48 hours before the attempt.

Ten ISO uplinks before the attempt (10 to 50 minutes before it every 10 minutes, then every 50 minutes to 300 minutes before it) and four recorded_at values written as Julian day numbers in text, 11 to 14 minutes before the attempt. julianday() reads those inside the 48-hour window; store.js recentUplinkTimes also bounds recorded_at by text (>= the since date, < the next day), which drops them before LIMIT 10.
